summary.most_important_finding: R06-039: the evidence_quote silently dropped SAP's qualifier 'not assigned to CO receivers'. SAP does NOT say that with no capitalization key 100 percent of debits go to the AuC; it says all debits NOT ASSIGNED TO CO RECEIVERS do. A blueprint built on the recorded wording would model CWIP as a total-cost sink and lose the non-capitalisable / pre-operative-expense write-off path to cost centres.
systemic_issues: Quote elision without ellipsis is the dominant defect: R06-015, R06-037, R06-039, R06-078 and R06-085 all trimmed a qualifier, parenthetical or override clause out of the middle or end of an otherwise real SAP sentence. Four of the five changed the strength of the claim; only R06-015 was cosmetic.

Ten R07 records (R07-082..090, R07-092) cite help.sap.com URLs that resolve HTTP 200 to entirely unrelated topics (Billing Element; Processing Status for Enterprise Projects CDS view; Settlement of an Asset under Construction). These are unusable as sourced and must be re-sourced.

Strong universals ('always', 'automatically', 'must') were repeatedly copied from SAP prose whose surrounding sentences make them defeasible by configuration (R06-078 transaction types 340/345) or scope them to one cause (R07-047 authorizations vs dynamic selections).
